stemMd: When did the translator choose to add notes?

options.label: A
options.textMd: When a misunderstanding would change the reader’s interpretation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: For every unusual word without exception.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Never, because the editor forbade all notes.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Only when a word was impossible to pronounce.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Whenever the editor demanded a longer book.

explanationMd: The translator’s criterion is interpretive significance, not unusual vocabulary by itself. She adds notes selectively where misunderstanding would affect meaning. This balances readability against preserving important differences.

distractorRationale.b: The passage explicitly rejects that policy.
distractorRationale.d: Pronunciation is not the stated criterion.
